name: 公開状態と直接アクセス人数を示すリポジトリ可視性カード
prompt:
Recreate the supplied GitHub repository access summary as a faithful Japanese localization. Match the 704 by 240 pixel source crop and its 2.933:1 wide aspect ratio. Use the full horizontal width and preserve the exact side-by-side two-card layout. Keep the canvas white and exclude the left settings navigation, manage-access toolbar, invitation row, and any surrounding screen.

At the upper left, place the bold dark heading 「アクセス権のあるユーザー」 at the same compact size and position as “Who has access” in the reference. Below it, draw two equal pale-gray rounded cards side by side with a narrow gap, approximately the same left and right margins, widths, and height as the source. Keep both cards aligned to the same top and bottom edges, with small internal padding.

Left card: in its top row, put the small uppercase-style muted monospace label 「公開リポジトリ」 at the left and a small dark eye outline icon at the far right. Under it, show two lines of dark text: 「このリポジトリは公開されており、誰でも閲覧できます。」. Beneath the description, place the short blue link 「管理」 at the same lower-left position as Manage.

Right card: in its top row, put the muted monospace label 「直接アクセス」 at the left and a small two-person outline icon at the far right. Under it, show the dark sentence 「1人がこのリポジトリにアクセスできます。」. On the next line, show the blue clickable summary 「コラボレーター0人。招待1件。」, preserving the exact counts of zero collaborators and one invitation.

Use the source’s compact GitHub settings typography, dark charcoal text, restrained blue links, very pale blue-gray card fill, thin outline icons, and modest rounded corners. Preserve the source whitespace, two-card balance, text hierarchy, and small card gaps. Do not invent extra actions, counts, labels, cards, icons, or decorative graphics. Keep all content inside the 704 by 240 wide crop.
reviewNotes: Canvas dimensions and two side-by-side access cards match the reference closely. Needs correction: the Japanese direct-access sentence wraps into two lines, making three body lines with its summary, while the source has two total lines. Version 2 will shorten the first line and retain the exact collaborator and invitation counts.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
